primary_research_question: For compositional visual queries, can independently scored object, scene, color, relation, binding, and OCR requirements reduce false acceptance caused by one dominant global similarity while preserving answerable recall?

hypotheses.H1: Conservative attribute coverage reduces false acceptance on compositional hard negatives by at least 30% relative to the frozen V16 global-similarity baseline.
hypotheses.H2: The selected V17 method loses no more than 3 percentage points of answerable Recall@3 compared with V16.
hypotheses.H3: Attribute diagnostics correctly identify at least one human-confirmed missing necessary condition in at least 80% of V16 compositional false acceptances.

method_boundary.implemented_first_stage: Attribute-level multi-query interaction over precomputed single image vectors; calibration showed that its strict coverage thresholds degenerated to rejecting every query.
method_boundary.selected_calibration_candidate: Top-1 candidate-level Qwen3-VL cross-encoder verification with geometric aggregation over independently scored necessary conditions.
method_boundary.not_claimed: Patch-level or token-level visual late interaction.
method_boundary.future_extension: Patch/object-region representations or stronger directional-relation verification; the current cross-encoder still confuses some behind/front and above/below counterfactuals.

frozen_baseline.name: V16 global single-vector retrieval and route-aligned rejection
frozen_baseline.rule: V16 holdout queries, labels, results, and post-run review cannot select V17 thresholds or aggregation.

human_evaluation.answerability: Each route contains answerable queries and hard no-answer queries formed from near-neighbor attribute, object, scene, or relation substitutions.
human_evaluation.language: Natural user wording; templates may define coverage targets but may not be copied into final queries.
human_evaluation.pooling: For calibration, take the deduplicated union of each run's Top-3 first, then fill by cross-run RRF to exactly 20 total candidates per query. This supports complete Top-1/Top-3 judging but not unbiased per-run Recall@10 or Recall@20.

reviewers.holdout: Two independent human reviewers for every pooled candidate and answerability decision.
reviewers.calibration: At least 30% double annotated; all conflicts and uncertain cases adjudicated.
reviewers.blindness: Reviewers do not see method names, scores, ranks, acceptance decisions, or query-author expectations.

human_evaluation.split_isolation: Group by source item, near-duplicate group, query family, and compositional transformation so related cases cannot cross calibration and holdout.

primary_endpoints.compositional_false_acceptance_rate: paired V17 versus V16 difference with 95% bootstrap confidence interval

holdout_rule: After the selected V17 parser, prompts, thresholds, aggregation, and code revision are hashed and locked, the final holdout is run once. Any later change starts V18 and requires a new holdout.
seed_failure: The yellow pyramid returned for 'yellow dolphin jumping over a desert pyramid' is a motivating regression case only, not a tuning-independent metric.

query_collection_progress.warning: The wording is human-approved and frozen. Calibration has 52 preserved human judgments plus a separate model-assisted visual audit; the latter is not an independent human gold standard. Holdout relevance remains unjudged.

calibration_retrieval_progress.pool_strategy: union of every run Top-3, then RRF fill to 20 total
calibration_retrieval_progress.warning: The capped pool preserves complete Top-1/Top-3 coverage only. Per-run Recall@10, Recall@20, and nDCG@10 are invalid. Model-assisted adjudication is for calibration and error analysis only, not an independent human gold standard.

limitations: Calibration labels are model-assisted rather than an independent human gold standard.
The false-accept paired confidence interval reaches zero.
Directional relation counterfactuals remain a known failure mode.
The final holdout has not been read, scored, or judged.
